patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-bleed dark blue/black backgrounds and full-bleed white backgrounds, creating strong visual breaks.
Headings are consistently very large, bold, and set in a modern sans-serif, often left-aligned, contrasting with smaller, functional monospaced text for labels or metadata.

A dominant deep, electric blue is used for primary backgrounds and accents, paired with stark white and a dark charcoal/black for text and other backgrounds, creating a high-contrast, tech-focused palette.
The hero section features a large, interactive radial network graphic that animates and scales down to become a smaller, persistent element in the sticky header after initial scroll.
Subsequent content sections are revealed with a subtle slide-up and fade-in effect as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
The 'Trusted by' section displays partner logos in a grid, each within a subtle, dark rectangular container on a light background.

technique_notes: The hero features a large, interactive network visualization built with WebGL/Canvas, which dynamically responds to user interaction and transforms into a smaller, animated icon within the sticky header upon scroll. This uses webgl-three and canvas for rendering.

Content sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, likely leveraging GSAP ScrollTrigger, where elements slide up and fade into view as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic content flow.

The primary navigation bar is sticky, maintaining its position at the top of the viewport. It remains transparent over the hero and subsequent sections, relying on the background content for contrast, and integrates a small animated graphic after the initial scroll.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) with smaller, uppercase monospaced labels and standard body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used across all elements, including buttons, cards, and section boundaries.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, while content grids maintain a balanced density.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, electric blue combined with stark white and black creates a bold, high-tech aesthetic. The interactive WebGL hero graphic that transforms into a persistent header element is particularly unique, setting a dynamic and sophisticated tone for a complex financial infrastructure product.
